visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white textured sweater and yellow nail polish, stands in a crowded exhibition hall with high ceilings and bright studio lighting. Behind her are large signs for 'Emdoor' and 'MSI'. She smiles and gestures with her hands towards the camera. (2) Close-up of a white, circular water-cooling head for a computer. It has a digital screen displaying blue rotating lines and then 'CPU Usage 5%'. The setting is a brightly lit display table with pink-lit fans in the background. (3) A laptop lid is shown featuring a detailed 'Great Wave off Kanagawa' ukiyo-e print. The 'MSI' logo is in gold on the top right. The woman's hands enter the frame to touch the textured surface. (4) Shot of a laptop keyboard with dark keys and yellow labels. The surface has a metallic sheen. The woman presses keys like 'pgup' and 'pgdn'. (5) A pink desktop computer setup is shown, including a pink monitor, pink mechanical keyboard with gradient keycaps, and a pink mouse. A virtual anime avatar appears on the screen, mimicking the woman's movements. (6) A handheld gaming device with a yellow and green shell (MSI Claw A8) is held by the woman. She interacts with the joysticks and buttons while a game plays on the screen. (7) A laptop screen displays a hand-tracking interface with green and red dots mapped to the woman's hand joints. She waves her hand in front of the screen to demonstrate the tracking precision. (8) A wall display shows multiple handheld gaming devices in various colors (pink, green, blue, purple). The woman points to them while smiling at the camera. (9) A large computer case with transparent glass panels reveals internal components, including multiple orange-lit fans and a liquid cooling system. The woman stands next to it, looking surprised and gesturing toward the scale of the machine.
